item.title: 36 Oxford Road, 1st October
item.description:

Whoever has just vacated 36 Oxford Road (an NHG property? https://www.nhg.org.uk/) should be held accountable for clearing their residents belongings rather than simply leaving them on the street for residents and the Council to deal with.

item.title: Untaxed vehicle still abandoned on public road for over five months, reporting again after required one-month period, 1st October
item.description:
I am reporting this vehicle again, as today is 1 October 2026 and the one-month period referred to in previous response has now passed. Vehicle registration: AV17 UYJ Location: River Park View, BR6 0NA I previously reported this vehicle and was advised that, under the agreement with the DVLA, enforcement action could not be taken until one month had passed from the date the vehicle became untaxed. The vehicle’s tax was due on 1 September 2026. It is now 1 October 2026, so the full one-month period has expired. This van has now been left in exactly the same position on this residential cul-de-sac for over five months. It has not been moved or used during that time. It remains parked on the public road, not on private land, and according to the GOV.UK vehicle enquiry it remains untaxed. This is no longer a recently expired vehicle awaiting renewal. It has been stationary for more than five months and is effectively being used for long-term vehicle storage on a public residential road. This is a small cul-de-sac and the vehicle is taking up limited road space and causing an ongoing nuisance to residents. I have already reported it multiple times and complied with the Council’s request to wait until the one-month period had passed. That period has now expired, so please can this report now be passed for enforcement action rather than closed or delayed again. Please arrange for the vehicle to be inspected and for the appropriate action to be taken regarding an untaxed vehicle that has been left on the public road for over five months.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): River Park View, Goddington, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
